tool.name: Perseus Setup Taxonomy Database
tool.description: download and build the ETE3 taxonomy database used by Perseus
tool.command: mkdir -p taxonomy_db && perseus setup taxonomy_db $update && tar -cf '$taxonomy_db_output' -C taxonomy_db .

param.label: Force update of the taxonomy database
param.help: Re-download and rebuild the database even though a fresh one would normally be reused

tool.help:
**What it does**
Downloads the current NCBI taxonomy dump and builds the `ETE3 <http://etetoolkit.org/>`_ SQLite taxonomy database that the Perseus `Extract Features` and `Filter Kraken2 Output` tools use to look up taxonomic lineages.
This tool needs to be run only once (or whenever the taxonomy should be refreshed). Its output is a single tar archive containing the taxonomy database; reuse the same output dataset as the "ETE3 taxonomy database" input for the other two Perseus tools.
-----
**Notes**
- This step downloads the full NCBI taxonomy dump from NCBI's FTP site, so it requires outbound network access and can take several minutes to complete. - Enable "Force update" to rebuild the database from a fresh download even if one already exists in the working directory.
-----
**About Perseus**
Perseus is a post-processing framework for refining Kraken2 taxonomic classifications, with a focus on long-read metagenomics (PacBio HiFi, ONT). It assigns confidence probabilities to each Kraken2 classification at every canonical taxonomic rank, allowing low-confidence fine-rank calls to be backed off to higher, lineage-consistent ranks or converted to unclassified.
